bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
cid=gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
docker inspect "$cid" --format 'state={{.State.Status}} running={{.State.Running}} restarts={{.RestartCount}} image={{.Image}} tag={{.Config.Image}} started={{.State.StartedAt}} exit={{.State.ExitCode}}'
docker ps -a --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=videobot-poll --format '{{.Names}} {{.Status}}'
echo LOGS_BEGIN
docker logs --tail 200 "$cid" 2>&1 | sed -E 's/[0-9]{6,}:[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}/[REDACTED]/g' | cut -c1-300
echo LOGS_END
if test "$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.State.Running}}')" = true; then
 docker exec "$cid" sh -c 'cd /opt/videobot && for f in src/runtime/creatorPollingMain.mjs src/runtime/creatorMigrate.mjs src/telegram/creatorWizard.mjs src/telegram/creatorUi.mjs src/telegram/creatorBot.mjs src/telegram/menuPanel.mjs src/telegram/creatorWiring.mjs; do sha256sum "$f"; done'
fi
stage="$HOME/.local/share/gace-create-videobot/opus-8f374cc-stage-20261125"
if test -f "$stage/build.log"; then tail -n 20 "$stage/build.log"; fi
if test -f "$stage/new.tap"; then tail -n 25 "$stage/new.tap"; fi
echo LOCAL_CHECKOUT
git rev-parse HEAD
git status --short
